docs.title: Hi, I'm TONY Gabriel
docs.text: I'm an IoT & Software Developer passionate about building smart systems that connect the physical and digital world — from embedded hardware and sensors to web dashboards and databases.

docs.title: 🔧 What I Do
docs.text:
• IoT Development — traffic light systems, door access, sensor networks
  • Web Development — login systems, REST APIs, data visualization
  • Database Design — storing and managing sensor data
  • Hardware Integration — working with LCDs, keypads, ultrasonic, temperature & gas sensors

docs.title: 🛠️ Projects
docs.text: A collection of IoT and software projects I've built during my development journey.

docs.title: 🚦 Traffic Light System
docs.text:
A simulated traffic light controller built with Python and physical LEDs.

  • Tech: Python, GPIO, Raspberry Pi / microcontroller
  • Features: Timed light sequencing, real hardware output

docs.title: 🚪 Keypad Door Lock System
docs.text:
A secure door access system using a keypad and database-backed authentication.

  • Tech: Python, Keypad module, Database (SQL)
  • Features: PIN entry, access logging, connected to backend API

docs.title: 🌡️ IoT Sensor Dashboard
docs.text:
A real-time web dashboard that reads and visualizes sensor data.

  • Tech: Python, HTML/CSS/JS, REST API, Database
  • Sensors: Temperature & Humidity, Ultrasonic, Gas
  • Features: Live charts in the browser, data stored in database

docs.title: 💡 Web-Controlled LEDs
docs.text:
A web interface to control LEDs remotely with a login/signup system.

  • Tech: Python, Flask/API, HTML, CSS
  • Features: User authentication, real-time LED control via browser
